"copyright protection", or requests to harden/distribute an HTML experiment,
or to lock a page to authorized domains only, or to detect domain switches
and show a fallback alert instead of a blank page, or to flag risky/abnormal
addresses (e.g. 192.168.x.x internal IPs) and interrupt with a warning.
